release.//: Determine next version via NX Release, sync to Directory.Build.props, generate changelog, create GitHub Release

restore.//: Restore all NuGet packages at the solution level; run after adding/changing package references

publish:nuget.//: MANUAL / LOCAL ONLY. API-key push of dist/packages/*.nupkg, retained for bootstrapping a brand-new package ID or out-of-band release. Routine preview/release publishing is keyless in CI via NuGet Trusted Publishing (.github/workflows/{release,publish}.yml). Requires NUGET_API_KEY env var and packed nupkgs (run `nx run-many -t pack` first).

format.//: Format all C# source files with CSharpier

test.//: Root meta-test barrel — composes workspace-wide gates that no single package owns. Mirrors the docs:test composition pattern.

_test:readme-conformance.//: GATING. Asserts every shippable src/ package has a README.md matching the per-package skeleton (H1=PackageId, lead paragraph, coverage badge for the package's codecov component, ## Install, and ## Mental model iff under src/extensions/). Pure function of the READMEs + csproj set + codecov.yml, so NX caches it honestly. AFFECTED CAVEAT: each README is owned by its inferred @nx/dotnet package project, so a pure README edit marks that package affected — not this root project. This gate re-runs under `nx affected` when codecov.yml, this script, or Directory.Build.props (a default input of every project) change; for a hard gate on isolated README edits, run `nx run flowthru:_test:readme-conformance` unconditionally in CI.
